snippet.title: Dream Garden | Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3367600/Dream_Garden/
Join Our Discord Community: https://discord.gg/NWN53Fw7fp

Dream Garden is an easygoing simulation game about creating tiny garden dioramas. Use a wide selection of plants, decorations and tools to build and nurture the garden retreat of your dreams.

Relax and immerse yourself in Dream Garden, a cozy simulation game about building perfect little garden dioramas with zen sand sculptures, lily-speckled ponds, trees, bridges, and more. Just sit back, de-stress and build to your heart’s content.

Wishlist the game now and follow us on social media for the latest news and updates:
